Landing.headline: Bitcoin options.
Landing.subheadline: Earn premium on your Bitcoin, or leverage its next move.
Landing.twoPathsSubtitle: Write options to earn premium upfront, or buy them for leveraged exposure. Same protocol, opposite plays.
Landing.earnYieldDescription: Collect premium upfront for taking the other side of a buyer's leveraged call, on terms you set.
Landing.leverageDescription: Pick a price and timeframe. If BTC clears your target before expiry, your position pays out. Up to 100x leverage.
Landing.writerStep1Desc: Connect a wallet and deposit BTC to your account.
Landing.writerStep2Desc: Pick a price BTC won't reach by a chosen date. Lock BTC as collateral and set the premium you want to earn.
Landing.writerStep3Desc: Premium hits your account the moment a buyer accepts. If BTC stays below your strike at expiry, your collateral unlocks automatically.
Landing.buyerStep1Desc: Connect a wallet and deposit BTC to your account.
Landing.buyerStep2Desc: Pick a price target and date, then accept an offer. Pay a small premium for leveraged upside. Your max loss is the premium.
Landing.buyerStep3Desc: If BTC closes above your strike, profit settles to your account on-chain. No exit timing. No liquidations.
Landing.chainAbstractionDescription: Isometric uses ckBTC, backed by the Internet Computer's native Bitcoin integration. IC nodes collectively sign Bitcoin withdrawals with threshold ECDSA, so no single node holds the key and no bridge custodian controls the BTC.
Landing.problemTitle: Bitcoin options are stuck on exchanges.
Landing.problemTitleSub: Custodial, gated, and built for pros.
Landing.problem1Desc: Coinbase, Binance, OKX. Your coins sit on their balance sheet. Their solvency is your exposure.
Landing.problem2Desc: Entire regions blocked by default. Where you can access, you hand over a passport to get in.
Landing.problem3Desc: Order books, option chains, margin modes, 50-ticker screens. Too much friction for anyone who isn't a full-time trader.
Landing.problemResolution: Isometric puts Bitcoin options on-chain. Permissionless, non-custodial, and simple enough for anyone to use.
Landing.teamLukeBio: Frontend and product. DeFi builder since 2021.
Landing.teamDylanBio: Full-stack engineer. Bitcoin, TypeScript, ICP, Rust
Landing.finalCtaSubtitle: Connect a wallet, deposit BTC, and take your first position. No signup. No KYC.

Buy.title: How buying call options works
Buy.step1Description: Select term, strike (% above current), and amount. We automatically find the lowest premium offer with enough liquidity. This premium is your max loss.
Buy.aboveDescription: strike — you auto-receive profit in BTC.
Buy.coveredCallsDescription: Writer's BTC backs the option. Max profit is option amount minus premium paid.
Buy.example: Example: 0.1 BTC at +10% strike, 2% premium (0.002 BTC). If BTC is $100k when purchased, strike is $110k. Expires at $121k → ~0.009 BTC profit. Max profit → ~0.098 BTC.

Write.title: How writing options works
Write.step1Description: Set strike (% above current), premium, and amount. Offers can be partially filled by multiple buyers — you receive premium instantly for each fill.
Write.aboveDescription: strike — buyer's profit settles from collateral. You always keep the premium.
Write.coveredCallsDescription: Your BTC backs the option. Max loss is collateral minus premium.
Write.example: Example: 1 BTC at +10% strike, 2% premium. If BTC is $100k when accepted, strike is $110k. Expires below $110k → keep 1.02 BTC. Expires at $121k → ~0.93 BTC (0.91 + 0.02 premium).
